singlePurpose: A user-operated workspace for managing Alibaba.com international products, gallery assets, RFQs, trade and logistics through documented APIs, including publishing a selected gallery image to the user's connected business social account.

permissions.justification: Stores user-entered gateway credentials encrypted with a user passphrase, local settings and onboarding state, durable product display mutation status without secrets or full responses, and an optional 30-day scoped device token for a user-controlled social publishing BFF. Derived unlock material and redacted diagnostics are held only in current Chrome-session memory. The passphrase is never stored, local/session storage is hidden from content scripts, and session unlock material is cleared by browser restart, extension update/reload, explicit locking, or the configured idle timeout.

Runs fixed packaged code only in the known Alibaba Application Center and OAuth tabs after the user explicitly starts credential acquisition. It does not execute remote code, collect the website password, accept agreements, or bypass human verification.
Sends user-initiated, signed HTTPS requests to the documented Alibaba.com Open Platform gateway.

Chrome grants only the specific host requested when a user starts credential acquisition, confirms the actual OAuth callback, configures a custom gateway, pairs a user-controlled social publishing BFF, or explicitly transfers an external image; grants are revocable in settings.
